words.hindi: उद्धार करना / दोष से मुक्त करना
words.meaning: Compensate for the faults or bad aspects of; save or reclaim.
words.example: He worked hard in the final match to redeem his reputation.

words.meaning: Deliberately hurtful and cutting in remark.
words.example: She made a barbed comment about his late arrival.

words.meaning: An impediment or burden.
words.example: Heavy luggage was an encumbrance during the trek.

words.meaning: A very short time; a moment or instant.
words.example: I will finish this question in a jiffy.

words.meaning: Express sharp disapproval or criticism of someone.
words.example: The teacher had to rebuke the student for talking in class.

words.meaning: Cause to become twisted together with or caught in.
words.example: The bird got entangled in the net.

words.meaning: Give a loud, sharp cry.
words.example: Do not yell at your younger brother.

words.meaning: Too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous.
words.example: Copying data manually is a tedious job.

words.meaning: Serious, sensible, and solemn.
words.example: The judge maintained a sober expression during the trial.

words.meaning: Give way to arguments, demands, or pressure.
words.example: The brave soldiers refused to yield to the enemy.

words.meaning: Comically or repulsively ugly or distorted.
words.example: The old castle had grotesque stone carvings.

words.meaning: A person who manages the financial affairs of a college or school.
words.example: Students paid their tuition fees to the college bursar.

words.meaning: Required, permitted, or enacted by statute.
words.example: Every cigarette pack carries a statutory health warning.

words.meaning: An achievement that requires great courage, skill, or strength.
words.example: Building the bridge across the valley was a remarkable feat.

words.meaning: Make a loud, harsh noise.
words.example: The parrot began to squawk loudly when it saw the cat.

words.meaning: Having or showing a composed or serious manner that is worthy of respect.
words.example: She maintained a dignified silence despite the insults.

words.meaning: A blurred or smeared mark on a surface.
words.example: There was a smudge of ink on his white shirt.

words.meaning: A practical joke or witty remark.
words.example: The students laughed at his harmless jape.

words.hindi: अविनाशी / कभी नष्ट न होने वाला
words.meaning: Enduring forever; indestructible.
words.example: Great literature leaves an imperishable mark on history.

words.meaning: Extreme physical or mental suffering.
words.example: The injured player lay on the field in agony.

words.meaning: Furiously angry.
words.example: Dad was livid when he saw the dented car.

words.meaning: Cut off the head of a person or animal.
words.example: In ancient times, traitors were decapitated.

words.meaning: Light and slightly contemptuous mockery or banter.
words.example: Their conversation was full of witty persiflage.

words.meaning: Changes of circumstances or fortune, typically ones that are unwelcome or unpleasant.
words.example: True friends stand by each other through all the vicissitudes of life.

words.meaning: Of or occurring every day; daily and ordinary.
words.example: Walking to the library had become part of his quotidian routine.
